logs.summary: Hurricane Polo rapidly intensified into a Category 5 storm off Mexico's Pacific coast, becoming one of the strongest hurricanes ever recorded in the Eastern Pacific. It weakened slightly to a Category 4 but continues to bring heavy rain and life-threatening flooding and landslides to southwestern Mexico, particularly Guerrero state. The storm is expected to remain offshore, but officials warn of significant hazards from rainfall and mudslides.

Red alerts and heavy rain warnings are in place for the affected areas.
